title: Dissociation
description: This mod allows dissociative systems and people with DID, MDD, and OSDD to enjoy the game with friends and show who they really are.
body:
Dissociation allows you to create proxies for yourself so you can be yourself with your friends.

![This is a screenshot showing a player with a nameplate above their head displaying three lines: their username "Kyxmu," a display name and honorific "Ms. Kyomu," and their pronouns "she/her."](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c024cb240ecadff514f15cd65d750e1b4f79e3ab.png)

**Features from this mod will only show up to other users of this mod**

# Features
- Proxy usernames and optional honorifics
- Options for full pronoun customizablility
- Skin changer
- Fully client sided


## Compatabilities
This mod should be compatable with every other mod because it is client side
